suggested_motion.exit: Push the drawer back into its sleeve.

suggested_motion.ambient: Keep package panels still; shimmer only small detail accents.
suggested_motion.exit: Fold the panel closed with eased perspective.

suggested_motion.ambient: Let the insert rise 2 pixels, then settle.

suggested_motion.entrance: Reveal the pack shell, then separate the product and its insert.
suggested_motion.ambient: Float the detached product slowly above the insert.

suggested_motion.entrance: Reveal the serving surface; stagger food or product components upward.
suggested_motion.ambient: Use a very small breathing scale on the decorative accents.
